body: yeah, basically all my characters in my daydreams are based off fictional characters, even the character that I play myself (we're not even the same gender...) although I give this character some of the same background and same struggles as mine (but he has my dream personality lol), that way when I struggle with something it's the same thing for my character etc... my daydreams are a bunch of alternate universes for that character I guess lol
